rules.description: Lawful basis for processing must be stated
rules.generic_fix: State the lawful basis for processing (e.g. consent, contract, legitimate interest).

rules.description: Data subject rights must be described
rules.generic_fix: Describe data subject rights and how to exercise them.

rules.description: Right to erasure must be addressed
rules.generic_fix: Add a clause covering the right to erasure / right to be forgotten.

rules.description: Data retention period must be specified
rules.generic_fix: Specify the data retention period and deletion process.

rules.description: Data Protection Officer contact must be present
Cross-border transfer safeguards must be referenced
rules.generic_fix: Reference SCCs or an adequacy decision for international transfers.

rules.description: Consent withdrawal mechanism must be described
rules.generic_fix: Describe how data subjects can withdraw consent or opt out.
Add a cookie policy describing cookie usage and consent.
Reference the 72-hour breach notification to the supervisory authority.

rules.description: Privacy by design must be referenced
rules.generic_fix: Reference privacy/data protection by design and by default.
State that only the minimum necessary personal data is collected.
Reference data processing agreements with all processors.
